title: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida otlarni sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan turga ajratasiz, some/any ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, a bottle of, a piece of kabi o‘lchov iboralarini ishlatasiz va 10 ta mahsulotdan iborat xaridlar ro‘yxatini miqdori bilan yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars: nima sanaladi, nima sanalmaydi
board: some / any · a bottle of · a piece of
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda qisqa xat va xabar yozishni mashq qildik. Bugun do‘konda, kafeda va uyda har kuni kerak bo‘ladigan mavzu: nimani sanash mumkin, nimani mumkin emas. Dars oxirida some va any ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, “a bottle of water” kabi iboralarni aytasiz va o‘n mahsulotli xaridlar ro‘yxatini yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we learn which nouns we can count and which we cannot. You will write a shopping list with quantities.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun qaysi otlarni sanash mumkinligini va qaysilarini mumkin emasligini o‘rganamiz. Miqdorlar bilan xaridlar ro‘yxatini yozasiz.

scenes.title: Sanaladigan otlar
board: countable: a / an + singular, plural with -s

examples.t: There are two eggs in the fridge.

scenes.say_native: Sanaladigan otlarni bittalab sanash mumkin: bir banan, ikki banan, uch banan. Birlikda oldiga a yoki an qo‘yamiz, ko‘plikda esa odatda s qo‘shamiz. Masalan, “a banana, two bananas”. Unli tovush bilan boshlansa an: “an apple”, “an egg”. Bu mavzu sizga tanish, chunki o‘tgan darslarda ko‘plikni o‘rgangansiz.
scenes.say: A banana, two bananas. An apple, three apples. One egg, six eggs.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta banan, ikkita banan. Bitta olma, uchta olma. Bitta tuxum, oltita tuxum.

scenes.title: Sanalmaydigan otlar
board: uncountable: no a / an, no plural -s
I like rice. (not: a rice, rices)
scenes.say_native: Endi qiyini. Ba’zi narsalarni bittalab sanab bo‘lmaydi, ular butun massa sifatida qaraladi: suv, sut, guruch, shakar, tuz. Bunday otlarning oldiga a yoki an qo‘yilmaydi va oxiriga s qo‘shilmaydi. “A water” yoki “rices” deyish xato. Ularni sanash uchun o‘lchov iborasi kerak, buni birozdan keyin ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say: Water, milk, rice, sugar. We do not say a water or two rices. We say some water and some rice.
scenes.say_uz: Suv, sut, guruch, shakar. A water yoki two rices demaymiz. Some water va some rice deymiz.

scenes.title: Qaysi otlar sanalmaydi?
board: Food: bread, cheese, butter, meat, fruit
Abstract: money, time, music, weather, information, advice, news
scenes.say_native: Mana eng ko‘p uchraydigan sanalmaydigan otlar. Oziq-ovqat: bread, cheese, butter, meat, fruit. Suyuqliklar: tea, coffee, juice, oil. Mavhum tushunchalar: money, time, music, weather, information, advice, news. Va narsalar guruhi: furniture, luggage, homework. Diqqat qiling, ularning ko‘pi o‘zbekchada sanaladi, shuning uchun xatolar aynan shu yerda chiqadi.
scenes.say: Bread, cheese and butter. Tea and coffee. Money, time and music. Furniture, luggage and homework.
scenes.say_uz: Non, pishloq va sariyog‘. Choy va qahva. Pul, vaqt va musiqa. Mebel, yuk va uy vazifasi.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan farqi
board: English: two loaves of bread, three pieces of advice
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada “ikkita non”, “uchta maslahat”, “ikkita mebel” desak bo‘laveradi, chunki bizda sanoq so‘zi bilan ot hamma vaqt ishlaydi. Inglizchada esa bread, advice, furniture soni bilan ishlatilmaydi. Ularni “some” bilan aytamiz yoki o‘lchov so‘zi qo‘shamiz: “a piece of advice”. Ya’ni o‘zbekcha mantiqni bu yerda ko‘chirish xavfli.
scenes.say: I need some advice. We bought some furniture. In English, we do not say two advices.
scenes.say_uz: Menga maslahat kerak. Biz mebel sotib oldik. Inglizchada two advices demaymiz.

scenes.title: Eng ko‘p xatolar
board: ✓ some bread, some furniture, some information
scenes.say_native: Uchta mashhur xato. Birinchisi: “an advice”, “advices”. To‘g‘risi: “some advice”. Ikkinchisi: “two breads”, “furnitures”, “informations”. To‘g‘risi: bread, furniture va information har doim birlikda. Uchinchisi: “I have a lot of homeworks”. To‘g‘risi: “a lot of homework”. Bu so‘zlarning hammasini yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Not an advice, but some advice. Not informations, but information. Not furnitures, but furniture.
scenes.say_uz: An advice emas, some advice. Informations emas, information. Furnitures emas, furniture.

scenes.title: Sanaladimi yoki yo‘qmi?
scenes.say_native: Har bir so‘z uchun ayting: countable yoki uncountable. Egg, milk, apple, information, chair, money. Har birini baland ovozda ayting. Shoshilmang, har bir so‘z haqida bir soniya o‘ylab oling. Savol shunday: bu narsani bittalab sanasa bo‘ladimi? Agar bo‘lsa, countable, bo‘lmasa, uncountable. Javobni inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say: Countable or uncountable? Egg. Milk. Apple. Information. Chair. Money.
scenes.say_uz: Sanaladimi yoki sanalmaydimi? Tuxum. Sut. Olma. Ma’lumot. Stul. Pul.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Egg, apple va chair sanaladigan otlar: bir tuxum, ikkita olma, to‘rtta stul. Milk, information va money sanalmaydi. Pulni so‘m yoki dollar bilan sanaymiz, lekin “money” so‘zining o‘zi birlikda qoladi: “two moneys” demaymiz. Hammasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, ofarin.
scenes.say: Egg, apple and chair are countable. Milk, information and money are uncountable.
scenes.say_uz: Tuxum, olma va stul sanaladi. Sut, ma’lumot va pul sanalmaydi.

scenes.title: Fe’l birlikda keladi
board: The news is good. Money is important.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir muhim qoida: sanalmaydigan otdan keyin fe’l doim birlikda keladi. “The milk is cold”, “The bread was fresh”. “Are” yoki “were” bo‘lmaydi. Ayniqsa “news” so‘ziga e’tibor bering: oxirida s bor, lekin u birlik. Shuning uchun “The news is good”, “The news are good” emas.
scenes.say: The milk is cold. The bread was fresh. The news is good. Money is important.
scenes.say_uz: Sut sovuq. Non yangi edi. Yangilik yaxshi. Pul muhim.

scenes.title: News — birlik
scenes.say_native: Ko‘plik shaklidagi so‘z ko‘plik fe’l talab qiladi, deb o‘ylash tabiiy. Lekin “news” bundan mustasno. “The news is bad.” Luggage ham shunday: “Your luggage is heavy.” Qoidani eslab qoling: sanalmaydigan ot, ko‘rinishi qanday bo‘lishidan qat’i nazar, fe’lni birlikda oladi.
scenes.say: The news is bad. Your luggage is heavy.
scenes.say_uz: Yangilik yomon. Yukingiz og‘ir.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap. Birinchi: bread is yoki are? Ikkinchi: apples is yoki are? Uchinchi: information is yoki are? To‘g‘ri variantni baland ovozda ayting. Har bir gapda avval otga qarang: u sanaladimi yoki yo‘qmi? Keyin fe’lni tanlang. Javobni inglizcha, to‘liq gap qilib ayting. Sizda bir necha soniya bor.
scenes.say: The bread, is or are? My apples, is or are? The information, is or are?
scenes.say_uz: Non, is yoki are? Olmalarim, is yoki are? Ma’lumot, is yoki are?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “The bread is fresh”, bread sanalmaydi. Ikkinchi: “My apples are red”, olmalar ko‘plikda, sanaladi. Uchinchi: “The information is useful”, information sanalmaydi. Mantiq oddiy: oldin ot turini aniqlang, keyin fe’lni tanlang. Eslatib o‘taman: oldin otning turini aniqlang, keyin fe’lni tanlang.
scenes.say: The bread is fresh. My apples are red. The information is useful.
scenes.say_uz: Non yangi. Olmalarim qizil. Ma’lumot foydali.

scenes.title: Ikki xil ma’noli otlar
board: coffee → a coffee (= a cup of coffee)
chicken: meat / a chicken: the bird
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi otlar ikki yo‘l bilan ishlatiladi. Kafeda “Two coffees, please” deymiz, bu ikki finjon qahva degani. Lekin umuman qahva haqida “I like coffee”. Chicken: go‘sht bo‘lsa sanalmaydi, “I like chicken”, jonli tovuq bo‘lsa “a chicken”. Glass ham shunday: material yoki stakan. Paper: qog‘oz yoki gazeta.
scenes.say: Two coffees, please. I like coffee. We eat chicken. A glass of water. I read a paper.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita qahva, iltimos. Menga qahva yoqadi. Biz tovuq go‘shti yeymiz. Bir stakan suv. Men gazeta o‘qiyman.

scenes.title: Some: darak gapda

examples.t: There are some eggs on the table.

scenes.say_native: Endi some. Darak gapda aniq bo‘lmagan miqdor aytmoqchi bo‘lsak, some ishlatamiz. U ikki xil otga mos keladi: sanalmaydigan otga, “some milk”, va sanaladigan ko‘plikka, “some eggs”. Birlikdagi sanaladigan otga some qo‘yilmaydi, u yerda a yoki an turadi. O‘zbekchada ko‘pincha bunday so‘z aytmaymiz, shuning uchun some ni unutmang.
scenes.say: We need some milk. There are some eggs on the table. I bought some bread.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga biroz sut kerak. Stolda bir nechta tuxum bor. Men non sotib oldim.

scenes.title: Any: inkor va savol
scenes.say_native: Inkor gapda va oddiy savolda some o‘rniga any ishlatiladi. “I don’t have any sugar” — menda shakar yo‘q. “Do you have any milk?” — sizda sut bormi? Any ham sanalmaydigan otlar bilan, ham ko‘plikdagi sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlaydi. Britaniya ingliz tilida “have got” ham keng tarqalgan: “We haven’t got any eggs”.
scenes.say: I don't have any sugar. We haven't got any eggs. Do you have any milk?
scenes.say_uz: Menda shakar yo‘q. Bizda tuxum yo‘q. Sizda sut bormi?

scenes.title: Taklif va iltimosda some
board: Can I have some water, please?

examples.t: Can I have some water, please?

scenes.say_native: Bitta istisno bor. Savol bo‘lsa ham, taklif va iltimoslarda some ishlatamiz, chunki biz “ha” javobini kutamiz. “Would you like some tea?” — choy ichasizmi? “Can I have some water, please?” — suv bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Bu savollarda any aytsangiz, g‘alati chiqadi. Mehmonni kutayotganda aynan some ni ishlating.
scenes.say: Would you like some coffee? Can I have some water, please?
scenes.say_uz: Qahva ichasizmi? Menga suv bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Some va any aralashishi
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: inkor gapda some. “I don’t have some money” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “any money”. Ikkinchisi: mehmonga “Do you want any tea?” deyish. Grammatik xato emas, lekin nozik eshitiladi. Mehmonga “Would you like some tea?” deng, bu odobli va tabiiy.
scenes.say: I don't have any money. Would you like some tea?
scenes.say_uz: Menda pul yo‘q. Choy ichasizmi?

scenes.title: Some yoki any?
board: 1) There is ___ milk in the fridge.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: There is blank milk in the fridge. Ikkinchi: We don’t have blank eggs. Uchinchi: Do you have blank sugar? To‘rtinchi: Would you like blank juice? Some yoki any ni ayting. Har bir gapning turiga qarang: darak gapmi, inkormi, savolmi yoki taklifmi. Shunga qarab some yoki any ni tanlang. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: There is blank milk in the fridge. We don't have blank eggs. Do you have blank sugar? Would you like blank juice?
scenes.say_uz: Muzlatgichda sut bor. Bizda tuxum yo‘q. Sizda shakar bormi? Sharbat ichasizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “There is some milk in the fridge”, darak gap, some. Ikkinchi: “We don’t have any eggs”, inkor, any. Uchinchi: “Do you have any sugar?” — oddiy savol, any. To‘rtinchi: “Would you like some juice?” — taklif, some. To‘rttasini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, qoida o‘zlashgan.
scenes.say: There is some milk. We don't have any eggs. Do you have any sugar? Would you like some juice?
scenes.say_uz: Sut bor. Bizda tuxum yo‘q. Shakar bormi? Sharbat ichasizmi?

scenes.title: Singular countable uchun a / an
scenes.say_native: Bir narsani aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, sanaladigan birlikdagi otga a yoki an qo‘yamiz: “a banana”, “an orange”, “a sandwich”. Some bu yerda ishlamaydi, “some banana” noto‘g‘ri. Va aksincha, sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a yoki an yo‘q: “a milk” emas, “some milk”. Qisqa qilib: a, an — bittalik uchun, some — noaniq miqdor uchun.
scenes.say: I want an orange. She has a sandwich. I want some orange juice.
scenes.say_uz: Men apelsin xohlayman. Uning sendvichi bor. Men apelsin sharbati xohlayman.

scenes.title: Idish va o‘lchov iboralari
board: a bottle of water · a carton of milk
a jar of jam · a tin of tomatoes
a packet of biscuits · a bar of chocolate
a bag of rice · a loaf of bread
scenes.say_native: Sanalmaydigan narsani sanash uchun idish yoki o‘lchov so‘zi kerak. Bir shisha suv — “a bottle of water”. Quti sut — “a carton of milk”. Bankada murabbo — “a jar of jam”. Konserva — “a tin of tomatoes”, Amerikada “a can”. Paket pechenye — “a packet of biscuits”. Plitka shokolad — “a bar of chocolate”. Xalta guruch — “a bag of rice”. Non — “a loaf of bread”.
scenes.say: A bottle of water. A carton of milk. A jar of jam. A tin of tomatoes. A packet of biscuits. A loaf of bread.
scenes.say_uz: Bir shisha suv. Bir quti sut. Bir banka murabbo. Bir konserva pomidor. Bir paket pechenye. Bir bo‘lak non.

scenes.title: Tuzilma: idish + of + ot
board: a / one / two + container + of + noun
a kilo of apples · a litre of milk

examples.t: I need a kilo of apples.

scenes.say_native: Tuzilma doim bir xil: son, idish, of, ot. Muhim qoida: idish so‘zi ko‘plikka o‘tadi, asosiy ot esa o‘zgarmaydi. “Two bottles of water”, “three packets of biscuits”. Of ni tushirib qoldirmang: “a bottle water” xato. O‘lchov birliklari ham shunday: “a kilo of apples”, “a litre of milk”. Amerikada “liter” deb yoziladi.
scenes.say: Two bottles of water. Three packets of biscuits. A kilo of apples. A litre of milk.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki shisha suv. Uch paket pechenye. Bir kilo olma. Bir litr sut.

scenes.title: Og‘irlik va hajm
board: a cup of tea · a glass of water
a bowl of soup · a spoonful of honey

examples.t: Can I have 500 grams of cheese?
examples.uz: Menga besh yuz gramm pishloq bersangiz.

examples.t: She drinks a cup of tea.

scenes.say_native: Do‘konda og‘irlik va hajm ham ishlatiladi: “a kilo of apples”, “500 grams of cheese”, “a litre of juice”. Uyda va kafeda esa idish bilan o‘lchaymiz: “a cup of tea” — bir piyola choy, “a glass of water” — bir stakan suv, “a bowl of soup” — bir kosa sho‘rva, “a spoonful of honey” — bir qoshiq asal. Qoida o‘sha-o‘sha: ot birlikda qoladi.
scenes.say: Five hundred grams of cheese. A litre of juice. A cup of tea. A glass of water. A bowl of soup.
scenes.say_uz: Besh yuz gramm pishloq. Bir litr sharbat. Bir piyola choy. Bir stakan suv. Bir kosa sho‘rva.

scenes.title: A piece of ...
board: a piece of advice / news / information
a piece of furniture / paper / cake
a slice of bread / cheese / cake

examples.t: Let me give you a piece of advice.
That is an interesting piece of news.

scenes.say_native: Mavhum tushunchalar uchun eng universal so‘z — “piece”. “A piece of advice” — bitta maslahat, “a piece of news” — bitta yangilik, “a piece of information” — bitta ma’lumot, “a piece of furniture” — bitta mebel buyumi. Ko‘plikda: “two pieces of advice”. Kesilgan bo‘lak uchun “slice” ham bor: “a slice of bread”, “a slice of cheese”.
scenes.say: A piece of advice. A piece of news. A piece of furniture. A slice of cheese.
scenes.say_uz: Bir maslahat. Bir yangilik. Bir mebel buyumi. Bir bo‘lak pishloq.

scenes.title: O‘lchov iboralaridagi xatolar
board: ✗ a bottle water / two bottle of water
✓ a bottle of water / two bottles of water
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: of ni tushirish, “a bottle water”. To‘g‘risi: “a bottle of water”. Ikkinchisi: idishni birlikda qoldirish, “two bottle of water”. To‘g‘risi: “two bottles of water”. Uchinchisi: “a piece of advices”, ot ko‘plikka qo‘yiladi. To‘g‘risi: “a piece of advice”, ot hamma vaqt birlikda.
scenes.say: A bottle of water. Two bottles of water. A piece of advice.
scenes.say_uz: Bir shisha suv. Ikki shisha suv. Bir maslahat.

scenes.title: Mos so‘zni toping
board: 1) a ___ of milk  2) a ___ of bread
3) a ___ of chocolate  4) a ___ of jam
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joyga mos idish so‘zini ayting. Bir blank sut. Bir blank non. Bir blank shokolad. Bir blank murabbo. Ikki blank maslahat. Variantlar: carton, loaf, bar, jar, pieces. Idish so‘zlarini yuqorida ko‘rgan edik. Har bir mahsulot qanday idishda sotilishini o‘ylang. Oxirgisida esa mavhum ot bor, uning uchun piece ko‘plikda kerak bo‘ladi. Javobni to‘liq ibora bilan ayting.
scenes.say: A blank of milk. A blank of bread. A blank of chocolate. A blank of jam. Two blank of advice.
scenes.say_uz: Bir quti sut. Bir bo‘lak non. Bir plitka shokolad. Bir banka murabbo. Ikki maslahat.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: a carton of milk · a loaf of bread
a bar of chocolate · a jar of jam
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “A carton of milk”. “A loaf of bread”. “A bar of chocolate”. “A jar of jam”. Va oxirgisi “two pieces of advice”: piece ko‘plikka o‘tdi, advice o‘zgarmadi. Kamida to‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, zarari yo‘q. Ibora tuzilmasini yana bir bor eslang: son, idish, of, ot.
scenes.say: A carton of milk. A loaf of bread. A bar of chocolate. A jar of jam. Two pieces of advice.
scenes.say_uz: Bir quti sut. Bir bo‘lak non. Bir plitka shokolad. Bir banka murabbo. Ikki maslahat.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: supermarketda
board: A: Do we need any milk?
B: Yes, a carton. And we haven't got any bread.
A: And there aren't any eggs.
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st supermarketda. Ular nima kerakligini aniqlaydi. E’tibor bering: some, any va idish iboralari qanday ishlatilmoqda. Savollar tinglagandan keyin beriladi, shuning uchun raqamlarga ham quloq soling. Bu dialogdagi raqamlarni va mahsulotlarni yozib boring: sut, non, tuxum, olma. Keyin savollarga javob berish oson bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Anna: Do we need any milk? Ben: Yes, a carton of milk. And we haven't got any bread. Anna: OK, a loaf of bread. And there aren't any eggs. Ben: Then a dozen eggs, please. And a kilo of apples.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Bizga sut kerakmi? Ben: Ha, bir quti sut. Va nonimiz yo‘q. Anna: Mayli, bir bo‘lak non. Tuxum ham yo‘q. Ben: Unda o‘nikkita tuxum. Va bir kilo olma.

scenes.title: Dialog haqida savollar
board: 1) How much milk do they buy?
3) How many eggs do they buy?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: ular qancha sut olishadi? Ikkinchi: nima uchun non olishadi? Uchinchi: nechta tuxum olishadi? Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Javob berishdan oldin dialogni yana bir marta o‘zingizcha eslang. Ikkinchi savolda sababni ham ayting: nima uchun?
scenes.say: How much milk do they buy? Why do they buy bread? How many eggs do they buy?
scenes.say_uz: Ular qancha sut olishadi? Nima uchun non olishadi? Nechta tuxum olishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: ular bir quti sut olishadi, “a carton of milk”. Ikkinchi: uyda non yo‘q, ya’ni “they haven’t got any bread”, shuning uchun “a loaf of bread” olishadi. Uchinchi: tuxum ham yo‘q edi, ular o‘nikkita, ya’ni “a dozen”, olishadi. Ko‘rdingizmi, inkor gapda any ishlatildi.
scenes.say: They buy a carton of milk. They haven't got any bread. They buy a dozen eggs.
scenes.say_uz: Ular bir quti sut olishadi. Ularda non yo‘q. Ular o‘nikkita tuxum olishadi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: oshxonada
board: A: Would you like some tea?
B: Yes, please. Is there any sugar?
A: Sorry, I haven't got any. Honey?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog uyda mehmon kutayotgan paytda. Mezbon taklif qiladi, mehmon so‘raydi. Qaysi gapda some, qaysi gapda any ishlatilganini eshiting. Taklifda some bo‘lishi kerakligini eslang. Bu mehmondorlik dialogi. Mezbon taklif qiladi, mehmon so‘raydi. Taklifda qaysi so‘z ishlatilishini, shakar haqidagi savol va javobda esa qaysi so‘zni eshitishingizni kuzating.
scenes.say: Host: Would you like some tea? Guest: Yes, please. Is there any sugar? Host: Sorry, I haven't got any sugar. Would you like some honey? Guest: Yes, a spoonful, please.
scenes.say_uz: Mezbon: Choy ichasizmi? Mehmon: Ha, iltimos. Shakar bormi? Mezbon: Kechirasiz, shakar yo‘q. Asal qo‘shasizmi? Mehmon: Ha, bir qoshiq, iltimos.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog savollari
board: 2) Why is there no sugar in the tea?
3) What does the guest take instead?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: mezbon nima taklif qiladi? Ikkinchi: nima uchun choyga shakar solinmaydi? Uchinchi: mehmon shakar o‘rniga nima oladi? Qisqa javob bering. Javob berayotganda dialogdagi so‘zlarni ishlating. Birinchi javobda some bo‘lishi kerak, ikkinchisida any. Uchinchisini o‘zingiz toping.
scenes.say: What does the host offer? Why is there no sugar in the tea? What does the guest take instead?
scenes.say_uz: Mezbon nima taklif qiladi? Nima uchun choyda shakar yo‘q? Mehmon buning o‘rniga nima oladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: mezbon choy taklif qiladi, “some tea”. Ikkinchi: shakar yo‘q, “She hasn’t got any sugar”. Uchinchi: mehmon asal oladi, bir qoshiq, “a spoonful of honey”. Ko‘rdingizmi, taklifda some, inkor gapda any. Qoida dialogda ham aynan shunday ishlayapti.
scenes.say: The host offers some tea. There isn't any sugar. The guest takes some honey.
scenes.say_uz: Mezbon choy taklif qiladi. Shakar yo‘q. Mehmon asal oladi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: some va of
board: a bottle of water /ə ˈbɒtl əv ˈwɔːtə/
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda some va of qisqa aytiladi. Some deyarli “sem” kabi, of esa “ev” kabi, urg‘usiz. “A bottle of water” — urg‘u bottle va water ga tushadi, of juda tez o‘tadi. Yana bir yaxshi bilim: advice ot, oxirida s tovushi. Advise fe’l, oxirida z tovushi. “Good advice”, lekin “I advise you”.
scenes.say: A bottle of water. Some milk. It is good advice. I advise you to rest.
scenes.say_uz: Bir shisha suv. Biroz sut. Bu yaxshi maslahat. Dam olishingizni maslahat beraman.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Meni takrorlang. Of va some ni yengil, tez ayting, urg‘uni asosiy so‘zlarga bering. Bu talaffuz mashqi. Meni diqqat bilan tinglang va ritmni aynan takrorlang: ma’noli so‘zlar kuchli, a, of va some yengil. Har bir ibora uchun ikki marta takrorlang. Tezlikni oshirmang, avval aniqlik.
scenes.say: A bottle of water. Some milk. Some rice. A piece of advice.
scenes.say_uz: Bir shisha suv. Biroz sut. Biroz guruch. Bir maslahat.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv
board: Strong: bottle, water, milk, rice, advice
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Esda tuting: ma’noli so‘zlar, ya’ni bottle, water, milk, advice, kuchli aytiladi. Yordamchi so‘zlar a, of, some esa kuchsiz. Shu ritm sizning nutqingizni darhol tabiiy qiladi. Ingliz tili ritmik til, har bir bo‘g‘in teng uzunlikda emas. Har gal gapirganda shu ritmni eslang.
scenes.say: Strong words and weak words make natural rhythm.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli va kuchsiz so‘zlar tabiiy ritm yaratadi.

scenes.title: Yana bir nechta tuzoq
scenes.say_native: Yana bir nechta tuzoq. Hair sanalmaydi: “She has long hair”. Weather sanalmaydi: “The weather is nice”. Work sanalmaydi, ammo job sanaladi: “I have a job”, “I have work to do”. Travel sanalmaydi, trip sanaladi: “a trip to Samarkand”. Vegetable sanaladi: “vegetables”, lekin fruit odatda sanalmaydi: “I eat fruit every day”.
scenes.say: She has long hair. The weather is nice. I have a new job. We had a trip to Samarkand. I eat fruit every day.
scenes.say_uz: Uning sochi uzun. Havo yaxshi. Mening yangi ishim bor. Biz Samarqandga sayohat qildik. Men har kuni meva yeyman.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) I need an advice about my job.
4) Can I have a water, please?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda xato bor. Har birini to‘g‘rilab ayting. Birinchi: I need an advice about my job. Ikkinchi: The weather are cold today. Uchinchi: She bought two furnitures. To‘rtinchi: Can I have a water, please? Har bir gapni o‘zingizcha to‘g‘rilang. Xatoning turini toping: noto‘g‘ri a yoki an, ko‘plik s yoki noto‘g‘ri fe’l. Keyin to‘g‘ri gapni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: Correct these sentences. I need an advice. The weather are cold. She bought two furnitures. Can I have a water?
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni to‘g‘rilang. Menga maslahat kerak. Havo sovuq. U ikkita mebel sotib oldi. Menga suv bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantlar
board: 1) I need some advice about my job.
3) She bought two pieces of furniture.
4) Can I have some water, please?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “I need some advice about my job”. Ikkinchi: “The weather is cold today”. Uchinchi: “She bought two pieces of furniture” yoki “some furniture”. To‘rtinchi: “Can I have some water, please?” Eslang: iltimosda some, kafeda esa “a water” o‘rniga “a bottle of water” aytish aniqroq.
scenes.say: I need some advice. The weather is cold. She bought two pieces of furniture. Can I have some water, please?
scenes.say_uz: Menga maslahat kerak. Havo sovuq. U ikki dona mebel sotib oldi. Menga suv bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Nutq mashqi: muzlatgichingiz
board: There is some ... / There isn't any ...
There is a bottle / carton / jar of ...
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz gapiring. Muzlatgichingizda nima bor, nima yo‘q? To‘rtta gap ayting. Masalan: there is some milk, there isn’t any cheese, there is a jar of jam. Some, any va bitta idish iborasini ishlating. Gapni sekin tuzing, shoshilmang. Har bir gapda bitta sanalmaydigan ot bo‘lsin. Xato qilishdan qo‘rqmang, bu mashq uchun.
scenes.say: Tell me about your fridge. There is some milk. There isn't any cheese. There is a jar of jam.
scenes.say_uz: Muzlatgichingiz haqida ayting. Biroz sut bor. Pishloq yo‘q. Bir banka murabbo bor.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: There is some milk and a loaf of bread.
There is a bottle of juice and some butter.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: “There is some milk and a loaf of bread. There aren’t any eggs. There is a bottle of juice and some butter.” Siz ham shunga o‘xshash gap tuzdingizmi? Some darak gapda, any inkorda, idish iborasida of. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, zarari yo‘q, qaytadan ayting.
scenes.say: There is some milk and a loaf of bread. There aren't any eggs. There is a bottle of juice and some butter.
scenes.say_uz: Biroz sut va bir bo‘lak non bor. Tuxum yo‘q. Bir shisha sharbat va biroz sariyog‘ bor.

scenes.title: Namunaviy xaridlar ro‘yxati
board: 2 bottles of water · a loaf of bread
a kilo of rice · some sugar
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifangiz uchun namuna. “Two bottles of water, a loaf of bread, a kilo of rice, some sugar, a packet of tea, six eggs, an onion, some fruit.” Ko‘rdingizmi, sanaladigan otlarga son yoki a, an qo‘yilgan, sanalmaydiganlarga esa o‘lchov iborasi yoki some. Ro‘yxatda har xil usullarni aralashtiring, shunda mashq foydali bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Two bottles of water, a loaf of bread, a kilo of rice, some sugar, a packet of tea, six eggs, an onion and some fruit.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki shisha suv, bir bo‘lak non, bir kilo guruch, biroz shakar, bir paket choy, oltita tuxum, bitta piyoz va biroz meva.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Uncountable: some, no plural, verb singular
bottle of · piece of · loaf of
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Sanaladigan otlar a, an va ko‘plik s bilan ishlaydi. Sanalmaydigan otlar, bread, advice, news, furniture, birlikda qoladi va some bilan keladi. Darak gap va taklifda some, inkor va savolda any. Sanash kerak bo‘lsa, idish yoki piece: a bottle of, two pieces of advice. Bu mavzuni mustahkam o‘zlashtirdingiz.
scenes.say: Countable nouns take a, an and plural s. Uncountable nouns use some. Use some in positive sentences, and any in negatives and questions.
scenes.say_uz: Sanaladigan otlar a, an va ko‘plik s oladi. Sanalmaydigan otlar some bilan keladi. Darak gapda some, inkor va savolda any ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Write a shopping list with quantities for 10 items
≥ 4 container phrases · ≥ 3 with some / a / an
Check: of, plural container, no a + uncountable
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘nta mahsulotdan iborat xaridlar ro‘yxatini miqdori bilan yozing. Kamida to‘rttasida o‘lchov iborasi bo‘lsin, masalan “two bottles of water”. Tekshiring: of bor, idish so‘zi ko‘plikda, sanalmaydigan otga a yoki an qo‘yilmagan. Keyingi darsda ko‘p, oz, biroz kabi miqdor so‘zlarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is a shopping list with ten items and quantities. Next time we learn much, many, a few and a little.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz o‘nta mahsulot va miqdorlar bilan xaridlar ro‘yxati. Keyingi darsda much, many, a few va a little ni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Xaridlar ro‘yxatini yozing: 10 ta mahsulot va har birining miqdori. Kamida 4 tasida o‘lchov iborasi bo‘lsin (a bottle of, a packet of, a loaf of, a kilo of), kamida 3 tasida some yoki a/an ishlating. Mezon: sanalmaydigan otlarga a/an va -s qo‘shilmagan, o‘lchov iborasida of bor, o‘lchov so‘zi ko‘plikda (two bottles of water).

quiz.why_uz: Advice sanalmaydigan ot: a/an va -s olmaydi. Some advice yoki a piece of advice deyiladi.
Rice (guruch) sanalmaydi. Apple, egg, banana sanaladi: an apple, two eggs.
Inkor gapda any ishlatiladi: We haven't got any milk.
Taklif berishda some ishlatiladi: Would you like some tea?
O‘lchov so‘zi ko‘plikda bo‘ladi (bottles), keyin of, ot esa birlikda qoladi: two bottles of water.
News sanalmaydigan ot, -s bilan tugasa ham birlik: The news is good.

options: I bought two loaves of bread.
quiz.why_uz: Bread sanalmaydi, shuning uchun sanash uchun loaf ishlatiladi: two loaves of bread.
Savolda any ishlatiladi, money esa sanalmaydi.
Furniture sanalmaydi. Bitta narsa uchun a piece of furniture deymiz.

quiz.q: In a café you say: “Two ___, please.”
quiz.why_uz: Kafeda coffee sanaladigan ot sifatida ishlatiladi: two coffees = ikki finjon qahva.
